newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General up as BZW reiterates buy.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General up as BZW reiterates buy.

text.p: Shares in UK insurance group Legal & General Plc gained over one percent on Tuesday on revived sectoral interest and a reiterated buy recommendation from BZW, dealers said.
Legal & General shares pushed as high as 785p in early trade but slipped to trade at 780p by 0813 GMT, up 10p on the day.
Traders attributed the gains to short positions and a revival of interest in the insurance sector following the merger of Lloyds TSB's TSB and Abbey Life insurance arms.
"That has brought insurers back into focus and we also have a couple of positive notes on the sector," one dealer said.
Angus Runciman, insurance analyst at BZW, said the Lloyds move had provoked interest in the sector.

"We've had Legal & General on a buy for some time and on the back of the Lloyds-Abbey Life news, we have reiterated that recommendation...one positive aspect from Legal & General's interim report was the dividend increase signalled," he said.
He said BZW had not changed any forecasts for Legal & General. Runciman said a 330 million stg pretax operating profit was expected for the full year after 271 million previously.
